# PullNova — LLMs.txt

> PullNova is an AI-native code review and CI/CD intelligence platform for engineering teams.

## Site Pages

- [Home](index.html): PullNova platform overview — AI-native code review, CI/CD intelligence, quality gates
- [About](about.html): Team, mission, values, and contact
- [Privacy Policy](privacy-policy.html): Data handling and zero-retention code processing

## Platform Summary

PullNova provides:
- **AI Code Review**: Context-aware PR analysis (bugs, security, performance)
- **CI/CD Intelligence**: Pipeline optimization, flaky test detection, 40% CI cost reduction
- **Security Scanning**: OWASP Top 10, secret detection, dependency auditing
- **Smart Refactoring**: LLM-powered suggestions in plain English
- **Engineering Analytics**: DORA metrics, review turnaround, code health dashboards
- **Integrations**: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Jira, Linear, CI/CD tools

Free for open source. Plans from $12/user/month. 30+ languages supported.
